reason: Both CIFs parse as fully occupied 20-atom P1 primitive cells with Na3NdTi2Nb2O12 (Z=1), the stated 242.307 A^3 cell, distinct Ti/Nb orderings, charge balance, sensible complete coordination shells, and no short contacts; the 23/24-line indexing is also credible. However, exact atom-coordinate recovery is not sufficiently established. The trace derives both models from one La-analogue framework and refines only seven symmetry-linked coordinate modes, without an independent scattering-density solution or broadly unconstrained coordinate refinement. Its instantiated final profiles give Rwp 0.11290 and 0.11311. Independent replay gives residual RMS about 0.458 versus off-peak noise about 0.125, with systematic errors at major reflections; allowing reflection intensities to vary at the same CIF cell lowers Rwp to about 0.084 even with the same crude line shape. Thus the remaining mismatch is materially diffraction-relevant rather than noise-limited, and another attempt is likely to produce a meaningfully different coordinate/symmetry realization.
